headline: Ken Paxton appears to cancel final rally of his “Come and Take It” tour at the Alamo
summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton, in a tight U.S. Senate race with Democrat James Talarico, visited Laredo as part of his "Come and Take It" campaign tour. No protests or civil unrest were mentioned during his visit.

headline: Hundreds march from Biloxi to Ocean Springs, calling for justice for Nolan Wells
summary: Over 500 people gathered in Biloxi, Mississippi, to protest the unsolved death of Nolan Wells, an 18-year-old Black man whose body was found off Horn Island in July 2026. Protesters, including activists from Black Lives Matter, marched to Ocean Springs demanding justice and questioning the official cause of death. The march was part of a broader movement calling for accountability in cases involving Black individuals who died under questionable circumstances.
